lines.zh: 我摆着细长的身子往下游。
lines.en: I wiggle my long thin body downward.
The deeper the trench, the darker the water.
My teeth are so long my mouth will not close.
The small light on my head glows.
I swim slowly along the trench wall.
One flick of my tail shoots me forward.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在暗处泛着银光。
lines.en: My scales gleam silver in the dark.
I rise a little, then sink again.
The pressure squeezes my thin bones.
I slip through a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 有影子在上面，我往下躲。
lines.en: A shadow above; I dive lower.
I swim fast, as if chased.

lines.zh: 沟底的沙被我一扫而起。
lines.en: My passing stirs the sand off the trench floor.

lines.zh: 我在冷水里慢慢地绕圈。
lines.en: I circle slowly in the cold water.

lines.zh: 我的牙交错着，只能张着嘴游。
lines.en: My teeth interlock, so I swim with my mouth open.

lines.zh: 头顶那盏灯，替我照前面的路。
lines.en: The lamp on my head lights the way ahead.

lines.zh: 沟越深越黑，我越游得顺。
lines.en: The deeper and darker the trench, the better I swim.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，穿过一排石柱。
lines.en: I turn on my side and slip between a row of stone columns.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，牙齿露在外面。
lines.en: I hang in the water with my teeth showing.
The light above my head flickers.
I wait for small fish to come to me.

lines.zh: 我的嘴合不上，只能张着。
lines.en: My mouth cannot close, so it stays open.
The trench floor is quiet, without a sound.
I slowly turn my head to the dark.

lines.zh: 一根旧骨头沉在我下面。
lines.en: An old bone sinks below me.

lines.zh: 我把身体摆成一条直线。
lines.en: I straighten my body into a line.

lines.zh: 上面的水有点亮，我不上去。
lines.en: The water above is brighter; I stay down.
I stare at a point in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我鳃边的薄片慢慢开合。
lines.en: The thin flaps by my gills open slowly.
The light goes out, and I light it again.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不小心的影子。
lines.en: I wait for a careless shadow.
The trench wall stone is ice cold.
You are huge; how did you get down here?
Your light is much brighter than mine.
I shrink halfway into the crack.
This mouth of mine must scare you.

lines.zh: 你在灯下不动，我悬着不动。
lines.en: You hold still in the light; I hang still.
My teeth are not for showing off.
Are you medium-sized or large?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不敢靠近。
lines.en: I watch your hand and dare not come close.
Do not shine that light in my eyes.
If you are leaving, leave quickly.
My thin body is bent by the blow.
A fang broke; my mouth closes even less.
My light is knocked out.
Scales fell; the water stings.
I desperately dive for the trench floor.
That nearly snapped me in two.
I swim crooked, and my light wavers.
The blood smell will bring big things.
I hide behind a stone and gasp.
I am too small for a second hit.
There is a faint smell of small fish.
The little fish in your hand is moving.
My light glows; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 我朝那条小鱼浮高半尺。
lines.en: I float half a foot up toward that fish.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了大影子。
lines.en: This smell makes me forget the big shadows.
I open my mouth and test the water.

lines.zh: 把手放低，我的牙够不到。
lines.en: Lower your hand; my fangs cannot reach.
I bite the fish, not the hand.

lines.zh: 那条鱼再近一寸，我就冲。
lines.en: One inch closer and I will dart at it.

lines.zh: 我的长牙从嘴边支出来。
lines.en: My long fangs stick out past my lips.
You knock me spinning twice.
My long fangs knock against the stone.
My thin body is squeezed and bent.

lines.zh: 我在水里翻半圈才稳住。
lines.en: I roll half a turn before steadying.
The water you push is all in a swirl.
My light flickers from the bump.
Do not press; my bones are thin.
I back into a crack to hide.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫到你，我不是故意的。
lines.en: My tail brushed you; I did not mean it.
After the bump I sink to the trench floor.
My light is on for you.

lines.zh: 两条细影子并排往下游。
lines.en: Two thin shadows swim down side by side.
Your fangs are a little shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 沟底那处石缝够我们俩。
lines.en: That crack in the trench floor fits us both.
Do not turn your light off; I cannot see you.
Let us wait for small fish together.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游了整整一圈。
lines.en: I swim one full circle around you.

lines.zh: 你游前面，我贴着沟壁跟。
lines.en: Swim ahead; I will follow along the wall.

lines.zh: 这条海沟很深，够我们藏。
lines.en: This trench is deep enough for us to hide.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍轻轻扫过你的。
lines.en: My tail fin brushes lightly against yours.
This meat sinks down; I catch it.
I bite it, and my fangs stick in.
Too big a piece; I cannot drag it.

lines.zh: 我把这块肉塞到石头底下。
lines.en: I wedge this meat under the stone.
This smells like raw fish.
I carry it down toward the trench floor.
My mouth will not close; I nearly drop it.
Hide it first, eat slowly later.
This piece lasts me two days.
Do not grab it; I found this meat.
A small fish rubs against the trench wall.
That shadow is small enough to swallow.
My light has found it.
It has not seen me and keeps swimming.
This size is just right.
I pull my body straight.
It is prey, not a hunter.
I sink slowly below it.
Its tail is trembling.
That one; I will not mistake it.
I follow it with my light still on.
It rises, and so do I.
My fangs are a hair from it.
It panics and swims erratically.

lines.zh: 我不急，它游不过我的长牙。
lines.en: I am calm; it cannot outswim my fangs.
The trench wall blocks half its path.
My shadow covers it.
One inch more and I bite.
It looks back once.
I coil my body, ready to dart.
My fangs stab in at once.
It struggles inside my mouth.
Once my fangs sink in, I do not let go.
That bite went wide.
My long fangs pin it.

lines.zh: 我甩了几下头，把它扯开。
lines.en: I shake my head a few times and tear it.

lines.zh: 血丝顺着海沟的水散开。
lines.en: Threads of blood spread through the trench.
It is smaller than I am and cannot break free.
I swallow too fast and choke a little.
When it is done I retreat into the dark.

lines.zh: 我在海沟的石缝里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in a crack of the trench.
It is so dark I cannot see the floor.

lines.zh: 还有一条同类在我旁边。
lines.en: Another of my kind is beside me.
My light comes on for the first time.
The water is cold; my scales rise.
First I hold still against the wall.

lines.zh: 这么深的地方，猎物不多。
lines.en: Prey is scarce this deep.
I swim toward the darker water.
A large shadow passes overhead.
I shrink into the crack and wait.

lines.zh: 热水把我和石头一起烫。
lines.en: Hot water scalds me and the stone.
I fall from the water onto dry ground.
Out of water, my gills stick shut.
The blast knocks a corner off the trench wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的背鳍，掉了鳞。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my dorsal fin and takes scales.
Strange force stiffens my whole body.

lines.zh: 沟里没小鱼，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: No small fish in the trench; I shake with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水打下来，我麻了。
lines.en: Lightning comes down the water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 我掉出水面，下面没有底。
lines.en: I fall past the water into no bottom.
